what: When the pointer is over a list row, a light band lays down behind the text in each cell from the left in 6 steps (.25s steps(6)) and the text inverts (cells delayed by 0·45·90ms), the first cell’s text spreads 4px to each side (.15s steps(3)) and an arrow outside the row’s left edge slides in over 3 steps (.15s). On release the band folds to the right end in the same steps — the feel of picking from the news list and schedule list like a game menu

options.[data-fx-part=label]: Text cells the band covers (multiple). First cell gets data-key="first" spreads to
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Arrow entering from outside the line’s left (optional)
options.--fx-hl-ink: Text color variable on the band, default --kf-bg
options.--fx-gap: Gap between arrow and line, default 12px

from.where: index.html and about.html news list and schedule list rows (original common-label-highlight: --d-slide .25s steps(6) · --delay 0/45/90ms · padding .15s steps(3) · icon translate steps(3)).
